name: Nabal
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: There was a very great man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel, three thousand sheep and a thousand goats, shearing his sheep in Carmel. His name was Nabal, and his wife was Abigail, a woman of good understanding and of a beautiful countenance; but the man was churlish and evil in his doings, and he was of the house of Caleb.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep and sent ten young men to greet him in peace: peace be to thee, to thine house, and to all that thou hast.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: Nabal answered, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master. He was talking much smack, as if he did not even know who David was, and refused to give of his bread, his water, and his flesh to men he knew not.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: One of the young men told Abigail: David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master, and he railed on them. But the men were very good unto us; we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing as long as we were conversant with them; they were a wall unto us both by night and day while we were keeping the sheep. David's men had been giving Nabal's shepherds protection from their enemies.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: Some of you women that want to serve the Lord are attached to some wicked men. On Clubhouse a lot of women say, we listen to you guys, but our husband is wicked. Here is a woman married to a wicked man: Nabal disrespected King David, and King David was coming to kill him.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: She did not turn her lord over to be destroyed, as some women today would be ready to do; instead she pleaded, Let not my lord regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him. She had not seen the young men David sent, or she would have stepped in then to protect their house.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: Abigail said, The Lord hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood and from avenging thyself with thine own hand; now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal. She asked, Forgive the trespass of thine handmaid; it was Nabal who was out of the spirit, but again that chaste conversation, stepping up for her household.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: She told Nabal nothing till the morning light, cuz he was drunk; when the wine was gone out of him and she told him, his heart died within him, and about ten days after, the Lord smote Nabal that he died. Sometimes you got to let God handle your beef. Like with the SPLC, the Lord is going to return their wickedness on their own head.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Abigail came home and Nabal held a feast in his house like the feast of a king, and his heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken; so she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: In the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things, and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone. Remember he had railed, Who is David? but when he sobered up and heard that the coming king had come down to destroy everybody in his house, his heart died within him. About ten days after, the Lord smote Nabal, that he died.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the Lord, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the Lord hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. Then David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

note.label: 1 Samuel 25: Nabal's Folly and Abigail's Wisdom

points: David passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath, every man with his household, David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife. When it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath, he sought no more again for him.

note.label: 1 Samuel 27: David Dwells in the Land of the Philistines

points: David went up with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite, and with every man and his household, and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

note.label: 2 Samuel 2: David Anointed King Over Judah

cases.name: Nabal
cases.charge: Railing on the Lord’s anointed and his men who had been a wall to his shepherds; who is David?
cases.preview: A very great man in Maon, three thousand sheep and a thousand goats, churlish and evil in his doings, and such a son of Belial that a man could not speak to him.
